pull.author: builder
pull.body:
This version delivers the PoemWorld domain package and the current HuTian source tree. It adds the `poemworld` CLI (`pw_` ids), poet/editor/reader organization and instructions, `poem.md` release gate, bilingual graph assets, system and worker images, entry-point registration, and installer/CI/check wiring.

Install on trial-machine from this release tree with `sh install.sh`; build `poemworld:local` and `poemworld-worker:local` from the same checkout. Run the repository regression checks, then run a fresh world with `Write a four-line poem about the first snow.` using Claude Code (`claude-sonnet-5-5`, low effort, `claude-oauth`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2`, 16 executions and 2000 model seconds). The target product PR is https://github.com/a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian/pull/17.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body:
Request changes for commit 22ef2a4695ce0b0893ed255369da0d9b7a213c7f:

- The 27 required regression, structure, and candidate-build statuses are all pending (the only completed status is hutian/delivery). Run the full regression and candidate checks on trial-machine/Docker and offer the resulting head again; pending or skipped checks cannot support a release approval.
- The bilingual organization graphs show a solid `editor --> reader` release arrow. The objective and Brief require exactly one organization edge, poet-editor; the reader receives releases and its dotted feedback is watched, but neither is an organization edge. Render the editor-to-reader release flow as a non-edge/dotted flow and document the graph convention as the other domain graphs do, so the assets agree with `organization.EDGES = ((poet, editor),)`.

The definition import at this head reports name=poem, command=poemworld, prefix=pw, roles poet/editor/reader, one machine edge, and reader watchers, so those parts are structurally present. After the graph and checks are corrected, I will review the new exact head; final acceptance additionally waits for the operator trial of that released version.
